text:
amanda: Quick preflight — shiproom tomorrow 11:00 PT. Need owners for sample apps, SDK packaging, docs changelog, and a small smoke test pass. I can run the shiproom notes.
kevin: I can take sample apps bundling + Docker images. ETA tonight 8pm PT. Will push images to staging registry.
mina: I'll do smoke e2e on current release branch (release/v0.9.7); test matrix: linux/mac, node/python. Start at 6:30pm PT.
oliver: Docs question — are we freezing the changelog at the merge-cutoff or at the shiproom start? I prefer cutoff 9am PT to give writers time to QA.
sophie: +1 9am cut-off works for me. I'll audit the quickstarts for API key instructions and function calling example.
amanda: Good. Ownership summary so far: sample apps -> kevin, smoke tests -> mina, quickstarts/docs -> sophie, changelog cutoff -> 9am PT (oliver to coord). Can someone own SDK packaging? @kevin any cycles?
kevin: I can do packaging as well but can split with oliver if packaging touches docs. I’ll own the binary/npm/pypi pipelines.
mina: FYI: QA will need a stable image tag. kevin can you create a staging tag like "release-v0.9.7-rc1" and push? I’ll point tests at that.
kevin: Yep. Command I’ll run:
```
docker build -t registry.redwood.ai/devex/sample-app:release-v0.9.7-rc1 .
docker push registry.redwood.ai/devex/sample-app:release-v0.9.7-rc1
```
I’ll post digest when done.
sophie: For quickstarts, small change: update node example to use the new streaming API snippet. I’ll open a tiny PR and mark it docs/quickstart-streaming.
amanda: Two small blockers — 1) changelog formatting (we need consistent component tags), 2) rollout note for Dedicated vs Hosted differences in sample app readme. Anyone can help standardize tags?
oliver: I can standardize changelog headers. Will do a regex pass to ensure [SDK], [Docs], [Sample] tags.
mina: Also need test creds for Hosted staging. @deploy-bot can you confirm a staging token exists, or do we need to request one from infra?
deploy-bot: Staging token exists: redwood-staging-token-qa. Expires in 30 days. Granting read/write on devex projects.
mina: Perfect. I'll coordinate with kevin on image tag and run tests once pushed.
kevin: Image pushed to staging with tag release-v0.9.7-rc1 — digest sha256:abcdef1234567890. ping me if any failures.
mina: Running smoke tests now. Quick note: skip long-model-run tests, only run quick prompting & embeddings.
qa-bot: Smoke tests started for release-v0.9.7-rc1 at 1956790500. Tests: quick-run, embeddings, auth-check.
mina: All smoke tests passed except embeddings latency on mac which flapped once — logged in test-runner: https://ci.redwood.ai/runs/2345
sophie: I found one doc typo in quickstart (missing env var note). I’ll push fix in 10m.
amanda: Great. Remaining action items:
- oliver: normalize changelog tags by 9am PT (done?)
- kevin: build + push sample images (done)
- mina: full smoke pass and CI link (done)
- sophie: quickstart PR + audit (in progress)
- amanda: prepare shiproom notes + roll call

amanda: If anything else pops up ping here. I’ll close this preflight thread after shiproom agenda posted. :thumbsup:
